comment: The design's colours. 'colors' and 'tagPalette' are the app's: DesignTokenTests checks them against src/Storage.App/Resources/Styles/Colors.xaml and Storage.Core TagPalette. 'mockupOnly' are colours the mockups draw with that have no token of their own, each with what the app uses instead. Every colour in screens/*.html has to be in one of the three lists.

mockupOnly.#F0ECE4: row dividers, stepper minus, clear buttons; the app uses Hairline or SurfaceSunken
mockupOnly.#CFC8BA: unchosen radio ring in the place picker; the app uses Hairline
mockupOnly.#B9B2A4: dashed outlines (+ Tag, add photo); the app uses InkMuted
mockupOnly.#D9D3C6: Move button outline; the app uses Hairline
mockupOnly.#8A857B: chevrons and row icons; the app uses InkMuted
mockupOnly.#A8A194: recent-search icons; the app uses InkMuted
mockupOnly.#6F6A61: search box placeholder; the app uses InkMuted
mockupOnly.#084A4A: link hover, a web-only state; Tertiary in Colors.xaml
mockupOnly.#EAF4F2: chosen row in the place picker; the app uses PrimarySoft
mockupOnly.#FCE7A6: search match highlight; FindPage.xaml uses it directly (dark #6B5510)
mockupOnly.#A6E2DC: camera screen accent on black; OnPrimarySoftDark in Colors.xaml
